subject: MAP: Integration build plan - Acme (SDK, streaming, tool calling)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft: Integration build plan

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — really helpful to see Acme's integration requirements and the success criteria for the pilot. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Integration Build Plan milestone. High-level recap below and next steps.

Recap / Key requirements:
- SDK integration: JavaScript + Python SDKs, server-side streaming client support, and example code for subscribing to streamed deltas.
- Streaming & long-polling: low-latency streaming for interactive features; fallbacks to chunked polling.
- Tool calling: runtime ability to surface structured tool call requests and responses (JSON schema + signatures).
- Structured outputs: stable JSON + schema validation for downstream processing.

MAP draft (attached: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf) — Integration Build Plan (high level):
1) Milestone: SDK integration (v1)
   - Owner: marissa_cole (Product / PM)
   - Target: 2027-06-15
   - Dependencies: example app, sandbox credentials, API key rotation policy
2) Milestone: Streaming implementation (server-side)
   - Owner: lauren_bishop (Engineering lead)
   - Target: 2027-06-30
   - Dependencies: compatibility tests, infra capacity on dedicated pool
3) Milestone: Tool calling + structured outputs
   - Owner: marissa_cole (coordinate with Acme integration team)
   - Target: 2027-07-08
   - Dependencies: agreed JSON schema, security review for external tool endpoints
4) Milestone: End-to-end validation + pilot
   - Owner: ben_carter (Sales / PD)
   - Target close (pilot): 2027-07-15

Immediate next steps:
- Please confirm owners and adjust target dates if needed.
- Marissa: I'll leave the technical milestones to you and Lauren to fill in required tasks.
- Alice/Tom: We need sandbox access (dev keys) and an initial schema for structured outputs by 2027-05-27 to hit the dates above.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft)

Thanks — I can schedule a 30m follow-up next week if useful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft: Integration build plan

Hi all,

I reviewed Ben's MAP draft and pushed a few technical clarifications — attaching the integration spec (integration_spec.xlsx) and inline notes below. Please consider this an engineering-backed MAP for the Integration Build Plan milestone.

Detailed milestone updates / owners / tasks:
- SDK integration (marissa_cole)
  - Tasks: publish JS + Py SDK samples, auth flow (OAuth2 + API key), add streaming client example (EventSource / WebSockets).
  - Blockers: need sandbox credentials and CORS policy for Acme dev subdomain.
- Streaming (lauren_bishop)
  - Tasks: enable server-streaming endpoint, implement chunked fallback, load-test to 1k concurrent streams per region, monitor metrics.
  - Blockers: dedicated GPU pool sizing decision (requesting staging quota from infra)
- Tool calling / structured outputs (marissa_cole)
  - Tasks: define tool-call JSON schema, implement schema-driven validation, example tool adapter for Acme's ticketing system.
  - Blockers: security review for any outbound webhook endpoints (Acme to provide allowlist)
- E2E validation & pilot (ben_carter)
  - Tasks: acceptance test plan, telemetry checks, sample prompts and expected structured outputs, pilot evaluation criteria.

Suggested timeline adjustments (engineering input):
- Move SDK integration target to 2027-06-18 (3 more days for sample coverage).
- Keep streaming 2027-06-30 but schedule an extra performance run week of 2027-06-21.
- Tool calling target remains 2027-07-08 but we need schema by 2027-05-27.

Attachments: integration_spec.xlsx (spreadsheet with endpoints, payload examples, and test cases)

I'll update the MAP PDF with these dates and tasks once we get sandbox access and the schema from Acme.

-Marissa
Product Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
